LEFT JOIN public.countries c ON c.id = a.country_id
LEFT JOIN public.provinces pr ON pr.id = a.province_id
LEFT JOIN public.cities ci ON ci.id = a.city_id
LEFT JOIN public.postal_codes pc ON pc.id = a.postal_code_id
ON ct.entity_type = 'country' AND ct.entity_id = c.id AND ct.locale = 'fr-CD'
ON pt.entity_type = 'province' AND pt.entity_id = pr.id AND pt.locale = 'fr-CD'
ON it.entity_type = 'city' AND it.entity_id = ci.id AND it.locale = 'fr-CD'

Use a Postgres function like get_patient_with_locale(patient_id, locale) to wrap the query above and expose via Supabase RPC.

Geo → Address: addresses → countries, provinces, cities, postal_codes.
Patients & Encounters: patients.primary_address_id → addresses.id encounters.patient_id → patients.id encounters.service_id → services.id encounters.location_id → locations.id.
Providers & Org: providers.department_id → departments.id providers.service_id → services.id.
Orders: orders.patient_id → patients.id orders.encounter_id → encounters.id orders.ordering_provider_id → providers.id orders.service_id → services.id.
Results: lab_results.lab_order_id → lab_orders.id → orders.id imaging_results.imaging_order_id → imaging_orders.id → orders.id procedure_results.procedure_order_id → procedure_orders.id → orders.id.

Meds: medication_orders.patient_id → patients.id medication_orders.encounter_id → encounters.id medication_orders.prescriber_id → providers.id medication_orders.medication_id → medications.id medication_administrations.medication_order_id → medication_orders.id.
Notes: clinical_notes.patient_id → patients.id clinical_notes.encounter_id → encounters.id clinical_notes.author_provider_id → providers.id.

1. Core idea of the patient portal
A single portal where a logged-in person can:
See their own EHR data (demographics, encounters, meds, results, notes).
See linked family members’ data (with explicit consent/proxy).
Switch between “self” and “family member” views safely.
Everything is driven by your existing EHR schema plus a small set of linking tables and RLS rules.
2. Data model additions for patient + family access

target_patient_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.patients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
proxy_patient_id = the person using the portal.
target_patient_id = the family member whose data they can see.
